name: Synchrony Premier World Mastercard

apr.notes: New accounts as of 8/28/26: variable purchase and balance transfer APR 20.49%, 27.49% or 33.24%; variable cash APR 23.49%, 30.49% or 36.24%; penalty APR 30.49%, 37.49% or 39.99%. Balance transfer fee 5% ($5 min); cash advance fee 5% ($10 min).

base_rate.description: 2% cash back on every purchase, credited automatically to the statement.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back posts as a statement credit within two billing periods after the purchase.

signup_bonus.description: $100 cash back as a statement credit after spending $1,000 or more on purchases in the first 60 days.

notes: Issued by Synchrony Bank. The product name carries the World Mastercard tier. Synchrony also offers the invitation-only Plus World Mastercard (1% cash back) and Preferred Mastercard, which are not covered here.
